# Final Cut Grill

> Final Cut Grill is a podcast by Chris Fenwick.

- [Final Cut Grill](https://grill.fcp.cafe/readme.md): Final Cut Grill
- [New Episodes](https://grill.fcp.cafe/new-episodes.md): You can find the latest episodes on YouTube.
- [Credits](https://grill.fcp.cafe/credits.md): Final Cut Grill has been created by Chris Fenwick.
- [Privacy Policy](https://grill.fcp.cafe/privacy.md): This is the privacy policy for the Final Cut Grill podcast and related online services (such as our website and support channels).
